Subject: Orinoco Labs — Vendor Master Data & PO Remittance Confirmation

Hi Elias,

Thanks again for the call today. To get Orinoco Labs set up in our vendor master and to ensure POs route and invoices pay correctly, can you please confirm the items below and return the attached onboarding form? I've highlighted the fields our AP team needs to create the supplier record.

Requested fields (quick checklist):
- Legal entity name (as registered)
- Tax ID / VAT (if applicable)
- Registered business address (line 1/2, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Remittance address (if different from registered address)
- PO contact (name, email, phone)
- Invoice submission method (email, portal, EDI)
- ACH details or bank letter for ACH setup (we'll ask for a bank letter later; you can redact account number here)
- Authorized signer for contracts / billing (name + title)
- W-9 or local tax form (if US vendor)

I've attached our vendor onboarding form to fill out and return: [Attachment: orinoco_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)].

Kimberly (cc) will own the AP entry once we have the completed packet. If you prefer, you can send the completed form and W-9 in one reply and we will progress to portal invite and vendor code issuance.

Next steps after we receive the packet:
1) AP validates tax docs and address
2) Finance assigns vendor code and uploads bank details to the secure vault
3) We issue a test PO and enable invoice routing (portal/email)

If anything on the checklist is unclear, let me know. Appreciate a response by end of week if possible — we have a scaffolded PO pending for your team.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
